candidates.violated_requirement: The match output should only assert when the shift register contains 8'b0111_0001, regardless of the current input value. This mutation incorrectly makes the match dependent on the current input being 1'b1 when the pattern is detected.
candidates.spec_basis: The spec requires match to be asserted whenever a_tem matches 8'b0111_0001, with no dependency on the current input value.
